title: Patch
description: Output of an Implementer or Refiner. Schema-validated at the boundary before it may enter the task store — an unvalidated artifact corrupts every downstream decision and surfaces far from its cause.

base_commit.description: Pinned base. A verdict issued against a different base is invalid.

root_cause.description: Refiner only: the hypothesis this patch tests. Required before any corrective edit.

notes.description: Free text. No other agent may parse this field.

confidence.description: Below threshold routes to a stronger tier or attaches a targeted question rather than guessing.

contract_deviations.description: Reported, never taken unilaterally. Routes to the Architect if the contract is genuinely wrong.

scope_expansion_request.description: Raised when the work requires touching files outside files_hint. Requires Orchestrator approval; unapproved out-of-scope edits fail Gate 0.
